raw: “I felt really happy when I found my lost wedding ring in the garden. There was a glint beneath the garden bench, and it was my ring. That little bit of light—it’s funny how something so small can catch your attention. I work in a lighting store, so light is something I notice. But it was the wedding date engraved inside the band that meant so much. It wasn’t just finding a piece of jewelry. It was finding my wedding ring, with that date still there inside.”
